verdict.rationale: Daily documents a server-side REST API for creating rooms, managing tokens, triggering recordings and controlling calls, and publishes an OpenAPI spec, so much of the platform can be driven programmatically. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches everything available in the dashboard or UI. missing for 10: explicit documentation of API/UI parity, evidence that dashboard settings (e.g., billing/spend limits) are API-accessible, independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
